title: RAG-for-DAG fitness metric = downstream task quality (gated behind judge)
summary: Decided how to evaluate whether RAG-augmented context discovery is a good fit for the orchestrator DAG. Chose fitness metric = downstream task quality (does better context discovery make actual task execution better/cheaper), NOT cheaper proxies (link-recall-vs-history, orphan-rate, cost-only). Consequence: this metric cannot run until the judge/merge stage exists, so the RAG-fit experiment becomes the first concrete consumer that forces the judge to be built. Sequences the self-learning-harness roadmap: judge → paired-replay harness → RAG retrieval layer.
